messages.author: e7773f79af9d66e4
messages.subject: Problem with malloc and PyStan
parts:
When I try to fit the attached model, I get the following error:

INFO:pystan:COMPILING THE C++ CODE FOR MODEL tdsz_lr_talk_763787ac780aba381abd865d0dac4abb NOW.
python(2242,0x7fff75c03300) malloc: *** error for object 0x1069cb720: pointer being freed was not allocated
*** set a breakpoint in malloc_error_break to debug
/Users/noahsilbert/anaconda/bin/python.app: line 3:  2242 Abort trap: 6           /Users/noahsilbert/anaconda/python.app/Contents/MacOS/python "$@"

I gather that the mention of malloc means this has something to do with pretty low-level stuff, and I have no idea what to do to try to fix it. It normally gives me this error right after it compiles the model, but yesterday it finished sampling from the posterior before giving me the error (unfortunately, the error prevented the samples from being saved).

I don't particularly want to post my data publicly, but I can share it (and the model fitting script) with specific people if that would help to diagnose and fix this problem.

Thanks.

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Problem with malloc and PyStan

Hi Noah,

Sorry this is happening. This is an interesting error.

Does it occur all the time or only sporadically? I've opened an issue on
github to track this: https://github.com/stan-dev/pystan/issues/137

Would you mind responding there?

Best wishes,

Allen
